info.title: Xenoteer Control API
info.description: Implemented Phase 4 HTTP control, observation, clipboard, capture, artifact, and viewer contract. Typed request and result definitions are generated from xenoteer-protocol and referenced from schemas/v1. Control WebSocket application messages are documented separately in websocket.md.

servers.description: Default container-local control plane; production TLS may terminate at a trusted same-host proxy.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Unauthenticated coarse process and desktop health.

tags.name: Commands
tags.description: Deduplicated generation-bound command lifecycle. Window control, clipboard writes, and text insertion are command variants, not standalone HTTP routes.

tags.name: Windows
tags.description: Generation-fenced window inventory, selectors, opaque references, and bounded waits.

tags.name: Clipboard
tags.description: Bounded clipboard reads; clipboard writes are submitted as commands.

tags.name: Screenshots
tags.description: Bounded root or exact-window capture into private artifacts.

tags.name: Artifacts
tags.description: Purpose- and owner-authorized private artifact upload, download, range, and deletion.

tags.name: Viewer
tags.description: Origin-bound one-time tickets, hardened static viewer resources, and the binary viewer gateway.

tags.name: WebSocket
tags.description: Authenticated WebSocket upgrade; application message shapes are in websocket.md.

get.summary: Prove that the HTTP process is alive

200.description: Process is alive.
Required desktop capabilities are ready; status is ready or degraded.

503.description: Desktop is not ready. This public route intentionally does not return detailed reasons.

get.summary: Read detailed server, desktop, and capability status

200.description: Current authenticated status snapshot.
Current capability report sorted by identifier.

get.description: The lease ID is disclosed only when the authenticated principal owns the active lease.

200.description: Redaction-safe current lease state.

201.description: Lease acquired. Location identifies the caller-owned lease.

post.summary: Replace the TTL of a caller-owned lease
post.description: The path lease ID and body lease ID must match exactly.

200.description: Lease renewed.

delete.summary: Release a caller-owned lease and wait for owned-input reset
delete.description: The DELETE has a required JSON body. Success means reset completed and the returned state is authoritative.

200.description: Lease release and owned-input reset completed.

post.summary: Submit or idempotently retrieve a command
post.description: The optional Idempotency-Key must equal command_id. A disconnect or transport timeout never cancels accepted work.

202.description: New or existing command is nonterminal.

200.description: Exact command ID and content were already terminal.

get.summary: Read the current principal-scoped command result

200.description: Current command result; Retry-After is present while nonterminal.

delete.description: Cancellation never promises undo. A 202 result may still be nonterminal; 200 means it was already terminal.

202.description: Cancellation was recorded and execution is converging to terminal state.

200.description: Command was already terminal and was not changed.

get.summary: Long-poll for a terminal command result
get.description: timeout_ms defaults to 30000 and must be 1..30000. A 202 response means only that the long poll elapsed; command execution continues. Wait admission is bounded to eight per principal and 64 globally, or one fewer than configured HTTP concurrency when smaller, so an ordinary-control slot remains available. Exhaustion returns 429 with Retry-After.

200.description: Command became terminal before the long-poll deadline.

202.description: Long poll elapsed with a current nonterminal result.

get.summary: List one bounded, atomic page of windows
get.description: Requires desktop:observe. The cursor is opaque and bound to the principal, generation, model revision, order, and query.

200.description: Atomic window page. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Evaluate a bounded selector against one model revision
post.description: Requires desktop:observe. Path and body desktop IDs must match.

200.description: Atomic selector result page. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Resolve a selector to one exact live window birth
post.description: Requires desktop:observe. Ambiguous selectors fail instead of choosing an arbitrary target.

200.description: Exact resolved window and opaque reference token. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Wait for one bounded window predicate
post.description: Requires desktop:observe. The model actor atomically checks, registers, and rechecks the predicate. Admission is bounded; timeout and resynchronization are represented in the 200 response body.

200.description: Satisfied, timed-out, or resynchronization-required wait result. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

get.summary: Resolve an opaque token to one exact live window snapshot
get.description: Requires desktop:observe. Tokens are principal-, generation-, and exact-birth-bound and expire.

200.description: Exact snapshot and model revision. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Read one bounded X11 selection representation
post.description: Requires clipboard:read. Text or small binary data may be inline; larger or policy-selected output is returned as a private artifact reference.

200.description: Validated clipboard result. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Capture bounded root or exact-window pixels
post.description: Requires capture:read. Window targets are exact birth references and are revalidated immediately before capture. Successful bytes are stored as a private screenshot artifact.

200.description: Capture metadata and private artifact reference. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.description: Requires clipboard:write. Release four accepts only purpose=clipboard_input, a single non-multipart Content-Type, an exact positive Content-Length within the clipboard-input limit, no transfer/content encoding, and an optional lowercase SHA-256 digest. The server binds the artifact to the currently ready desktop generation.

requestBody.description: Raw bytes with one explicit non-multipart Content-Type; this is not a JSON or multipart upload.

201.description: Private immutable artifact metadata. Location includes the required desktop scope query.

get.summary: Stream an authorized immutable artifact or one byte range
get.description: Grant requirements depend on stored purpose: clipboard:read for clipboard output, capture:read for screenshots, or artifact:read for action traces/support bundles. Clipboard-input artifacts are command inputs and are not downloadable through this route. Possession of an artifact ID grants no authority. Exactly zero or one single bytes Range header is accepted; multi-range requests are rejected with 416.

delete.description: clipboard:write permits deletion of caller-owned clipboard input. artifact:delete permits traces/support bundles; deleting clipboard output or screenshots additionally requires the originating clipboard:read or capture:read grant. Owner/share, purpose, scope, generation, and expiry are rechecked in the private store.

204.description: Artifact deleted. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived, origin-bound, single-use viewer ticket
post.description: Requires viewer:read and exactly one allowlisted Origin header. The returned secret is bearer material for the viewer gateway only; it must not be logged or placed in a URL.

201.description: Single-use ticket. Cache-Control is private, no-store.

get.summary: Load the hardened query-free viewer shell
get.description: Public static bootstrap page for the current ready desktop lifetime. It accepts no query string and contains no ticket or long-lived credential.

200.description: Hardened no-store HTML viewer shell.

404.description: Viewer disabled, route scope stale, malformed, or query string present.

get.summary: Load the fixed hardened viewer stylesheet

200.description: No-store CSS.

get.summary: Load the fixed hardened viewer bootstrap module

200.description: No-store JavaScript module.

get.summary: Load one allowlisted module from the pinned noVNC closure
get.description: The implementation route is an Axum catch-all. Only preloaded allowlisted module paths are served; arbitrary filesystem paths are never resolved.

200.description: No-store JavaScript module.

404.description: Viewer disabled or module is not in the fixed asset closure.

get.summary: Consume a one-time ticket and open the binary view-only gateway
get.description: This route does not accept the long-lived API Bearer credential. It requires an allowlisted Origin and exactly one binary subprotocol plus one xenoteer.ticket.<secret> subprotocol. The ticket is atomically consumed and all scope, generation, origin, audience, mode, expiry, and single-use claims are rechecked before the backend connection. Only binary frames are bridged; input, clipboard, and resize are disabled.

101.description: Switching Protocols using the binary subprotocol.

403.description: Malformed upgrade, denied origin, invalid/expired/consumed ticket, stale scope, or claim mismatch. Response is content-free.

429.description: Viewer or global WebSocket capacity is full. Response is content-free.

503.description: Viewer gateway or backend is unavailable. Response is content-free.

get.x-xenoteer-viewer-protocol: Opaque binary RFB/noVNC bridge; text frames and browser-to-desktop control are rejected.

get.summary: Upgrade to the v1 text-JSON application protocol
get.description: The HTTP exchange is an RFC 6455 upgrade. See websocket.md for implemented message shapes, including owner-scoped process.exited events and global metadata-free resynchronization barriers. Browser Origin is checked against an exact allowlist; non-browser clients may omit it.

bearerAuth.description: Exactly one long-lived API Bearer credential. The token is opaque and must not be placed in URLs. The closed grant vocabulary is desktop:status, desktop:observe, input:control, application:launch, application:terminate, window:control, clipboard:read, clipboard:write, capture:read, artifact:read, artifact:delete, and viewer:read. This scheme is not accepted by the viewer gateway WebSocket.

viewerTicketSubprotocol.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
viewerTicketSubprotocol.description: A short-lived single-use viewer ticket carried only as the xenoteer.ticket.<secret> WebSocket subprotocol alongside the exact binary subprotocol. Never place the secret in a URL or log it.

DesktopIdQuery.name: desktop_id
DesktopIdQuery.description: Desktop resource to which artifact access is fenced.

WindowReferenceToken.name: reference_token
WindowReferenceToken.description: Opaque principal- and exact-window-birth-bound token; it is not an XID.

WindowCursorQuery.name: cursor
WindowCursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding list page.

ArtifactId.name: artifact_id
ArtifactId.description: Opaque non-nil artifact identifier; possession grants no authority.

ContentLength.name: Content-Length
ContentLength.description: Canonical positive decimal byte length, checked again while streaming.

ContentSha256.name: x-content-sha256
ContentSha256.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 digest checked while streaming.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: At most one bytes range: start-end, start-, or -suffix. Multiple headers or comma-separated ranges are unsatisfiable.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exactly one allowlisted canonical HTTP(S) browser origin.

ViewerSubprotocol.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
ViewerSubprotocol.description: Exactly the binary protocol and one xenoteer.ticket.<secret> protocol, with no unknown or duplicate entries.

ViewerAsset.name: asset
ViewerAsset.description: Relative module path within the preloaded, allowlisted noVNC asset closure.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: When present exactly once, must equal the textual command_id from the body.

Location.description: Canonical command, caller-owned lease, or private artifact resource.

RetryAfter.description: Current implementation emits 1 second for nonterminal command results and backoff responses.

OptionalRetryAfter.description: Present with value 1 while the returned command result is nonterminal; absent when terminal.

x-content-sha256.description: Digest of the complete immutable artifact, including for a ranged response.

ArtifactPartialBody.description: One satisfiable byte range from the immutable artifact.

Content-Range.description: Selected inclusive range and complete artifact length.

x-content-sha256.description: Digest of the complete immutable artifact, not merely the selected range.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: The Range header is malformed, duplicated, multi-range, or outside the immutable object.

x-content-sha256.description: Digest of the complete immutable artifact.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid path/query/header, strict-shape failure, or unsupported protocol major.

Unauthorized.description: A valid Bearer credential is required.

Forbidden.description: The principal lacks the required grant, or a browser WebSocket Origin is denied.

NotFound.description: The requested versioned resource does not exist or may not be disclosed.

Conflict.description: Stale generation, lease conflict, command ID/content conflict, or unsafe cancellation stage.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the configured ordinary-message byte limit.

UnsupportedByTarget.description: The target cannot perform the structurally valid operation.

TooManyRequests.description: A bounded admission slot, queue, rate limit, or quota is full.

CapabilityUnavailable.description: The desktop or required subsystem is not ready.

RequestOutcomeUnknown.description: The handler deadline elapsed after dispatch. This does not cancel accepted work.
